title: gp-scuderia runner task file
description: Input to a framework runner: which goldens to run. The runner reads each golden's own x-reference.Xnew.

golden.description: Path to the golden (JSON twin for Octave runners)

timing.description: Optional. Time the evaluation (build model from the golden, log likelihood and prediction): one cold call, then warmup untimed calls, then repeats timed calls. The result then carries timing.
